_about: Methanol (1) + Methyl oleate (2): isobaric T-x-y at 101.0 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of methanol, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of methanol, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: C. Silva, L. Soh, A. Barberio, J. Zimmerman, W. D. Seider, Phase equilibria of triolein to biodiesel reactor systems, Fluid Phase Equilib. 409 (2016) 171-192
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 1, 2. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Consistency point test (Redlich-Kister fit to T-x): mean |dy| 0.0013. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
